jobs.recipient: a man in a grey muffler under the Vleeshuis arch
jobs.pitch: A bundle for a friend who waits under the Vleeshuis arch. Don't look inside, and don't be seen with it.

jobs.title: A crate off the lighter
jobs.pitch: A crate off my lighter at the ferry pontoon, up to the Steen gate before the water police wake. Quick and quiet.

jobs.title: Barrels, no names
jobs.pitch: Two barrels from the west canal quay to the brewery door. No names, no questions, and mind the edge.

jobs.title: Keep a lookout
jobs.pitch: Stand on the Petit Bassin quay till the bell and keep your eyes on the street. Anyone comes, you never saw me.
